_what: [RETIRED 2026-09-16 -> t-opt-t16.json for new evidence] [RETIRED 2026-09-16 -> t-opt-t16.json] T11 synthetic-light scan: the !synth fixture lifts the single-client 2-light ceiling so the occl-table mode-1 branch (row_b1, light slots 4..7) can be exercised. Sessions differ by viewport height because occlTable8 requires viewHeight>=512: V800 (800p) routes slots 4..7 to block1/row_b1, V480 (480p, height<512 but >=256 so block0 still works) forces slots 4..7 back to per-sample DDA. Same N + two heights = single-variable control for the row_b1 branch.
_conversion: total ssbo count = 2 (self handheld + gun light) + N (!synth N). MAX_SYNTH=6 (SSBO cap 8). minLights is written in TOTAL COUNT terms: T=4 -> N=2, T=5 -> N=3, T=6 -> N=4, T=8 -> N=6.
_run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\opt-verify-taclight.ps1 -Spec tickets\t-opt-synth-matrix.json -Session V800 -BenchReps 3 -BenchWarmup 1 -Evidence ...\qa4\run-out-V800   (then edit options.txt overrideHeight=480, RESTART, run -Session V480)
_prereq: Single client. The driver writes each arm relay pre-state including !synth N; the tail reset sends !synth 0. Default-off proof: never sending !synth leaves ssbo count=2 exactly as before.

_judgment.delta_definition: Delta_H(N) = medianFPS(tm on, occl off, count=N) - medianFPS(tm on, occl on, count=N) at viewport height H
_judgment.criterion_B: r(H) = Delta_H(N)/Delta_H(4). Prediction: r(800p) ~ N/4 (all N lights table-served) vs r(480p) ~ 1 (only slots 0..3 table-served, slots 4..7 fall back to DDA). r(800p) > r(480p) with gap ~ (N-4)/4 is the behavioural evidence that occlTable8 routed slots 4..7 to the table at 800p.
_judgment.why_not_delta_growth: Delta growing with N only proves MORE lights use the table: slots 0..3 (block0) and 4..7 (row_b1) call the SAME function taclight_occl_table_row_at, only the y offset differs (adapter:84-86), so there is NO cost jump at N=4->5 and Delta growth cannot identify row_b1.
_judgment.cross_check: tm off pair (b-t6 vs dtmoff-t6) at the same count: with TM off the two arms render differently and any history divergence is excluded.
_judgment.if_both_fail: Report the three-layer inference chain (code index condition i<8 + ssbo count>=5 + perf scaling with light count) and DO NOT claim row_b1 was directly observed. Direct observation would need a shader-side counter (shader change, separately approved).
_judgment.a_arm: A must show count=0 (all lamps and synth off)
_judgment.flags_gate: every occl-on arm must show header flags with bit4=0x10 (driver requireFlags) -- without it the voxel grid is invalid and the numbers are unrelated to row_b1

_min_decisive: V800 + V480 with 6 arms each: c-t4, d-t4, c-t6, d-t6, c-t8, d-t8 (the r(H) numerator/denominator). The full set adds the T=5 tier, the six-arm ablation at T=8 and the tm-off cross-check pair.
scoped: window (options.txt fullscreen:false) / resolution per session (V800=1280x800, V480=1280x480; change overrideHeight and RESTART the client) / dev save test / scene wall / pose wall_front(2000.0,121.5,8.0,yaw180,pitch5) / midnight+clear+doMobSpawning false / wait 20 / single client + synthetic lights (!synth N, total ssbo count = 2+N) / cone default / relay !bench x3 median is PRIMARY, ticket bench is SECONDARY
